What_Concept_Was_Discovered_Feedback: At first I only changed the intercept and my residual lines were huge.
Adjusting slope (m) and intercept (c) together minimized the squared error much faster.
High polynomial degree gave low training error in Level 2 but ruined the test error (overfitting).
Removing the extreme outliers and keeping degree=1 fixed the regression line.
Linear regression predicted probabilities above 1 and below 0 on binary data.
Using the Sigmoid curve and shifting the 0.5 probability threshold separated the two classes cleanly.
